assets.prompt: Create a new original landscape background for STARLIT GUILD stage 1-6, 1536x1024 PNG. Polished hand-painted Japanese fantasy storybook/anime environment, lush woodland wetland in early afternoon. Ferns, scattered SMALL patches of ordinary dark green non-glowing moss on damp stones and roots, shallow pools along the edges, dappled soft sunlight through leafy canopy, a firm walkable earthy strip across the lower middle left-to-right for overlaid small game characters. Quiet, intimate nearby forest, inviting natural green and soft earth colors, detailed but readable on a phone. Single full-bleed scene. No characters, monsters, buildings, tower, ruins, lanterns, magic, luminous moss, text, letters, UI, borders, logos or watermark. Clear broad ground space across lower-middle for gameplay sprites, not a wall of plants.
assets.usage: forest-wetlandのクエスト一覧と冒険マップ

review: 背景の通行スペース、発光しない苔、文字・人物・塔の不在を目視確認。保存先と表示をテスト。
